## About
Apex Auto & Transmission Repair is a local shop on University Ave NW in Coon Rapids. Sang and his team handle general auto repair and transmission work.
Some of our customers have been bringing their cars to us for years, and they send their friends and family too. We're rated 4.6 from 113 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn your trust the same way.

## Services
- Transmission repair: Transmission work is right there in our name, along with general auto repair.
- Replacing a clutch that went out: One customer brought us a clutch that went out, and we took care of it.
